འཐུང་བ: drinking ('thung, the present stem of 'to drink' (past btungs), + -ba)
ཆུ་ལྷ: water god, Water Goddess (chu 'water' + lha 'god'); a goddess's name
སྦྲུལ་ཞགས: snake-noose, a noose of snakes (sbrul 'snake' + zhags 'noose')
རི: mountain, hill (ri); where it gives no sense, perhaps a syllable set twice by mistake (uncertain)
རྩལ: energy, skill, play (rtsal): what awareness shows of itself
སྟོང་པའི: of the empty, of emptiness (stong pa 'empty' + -'i 'of')
ཁྲོ་བའི: of wrath, wrathful (khro ba 'wrath, to be wrathful' + -'i 'of')

བྲེད་པས: because of dreading, because (one) is scared (bred 'to be scared, to dread' + -pas 'because')
སྣོན་མར: as printed, uncertain: perhaps to an addition (snon 'to add' + -ma + -r 'to'); the sense of the phrase is not sure
འགྲོ་གོ: go ('gro 'to go' + the sentence-ending -go); also written as one syllable, 'grog
གཤིན་རྗེ་རུ: as Lords of Death (gshin rje 'Lord of the Dead, Yama' + -ru 'as')
རི་རབ: Mount Meru, the mountain at the centre of the world (ri 'mountain' + rab 'supreme'; Sanskrit meru)
བརྩེགས་པ: piled up, stacked (brtsegs 'piled up', past of rtseg, + -pa)
སྣང་སྲིད: appearance and existence, all that appears and is, the whole world (snang 'appear' + srid 'existence')
སངས་རྒྱས་སོ: become a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha, to awaken' + the sentence-ending -so)

རྫོགས་སངས་རྒྱས: perfect buddha, complete buddhahood (rdzogs 'complete' + sangs rgyas 'buddha')
སང་རེས: uncertain: sang res is no known phrase; probably for da res 'this time, now' (res 'turn, time')

གཤིན་རྗེ: Lord of the Dead, Yama (gshin rje); also the fierce figures of his court
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོའི: of the King of the Teaching (chos kyi rgyal po 'king of the dharma' + -'i 'of'): Dharmarāja, a name of Yama

རྒྱའོ: expand, open out (rgya, the second syllable of the verb sangs rgya 'to awaken', + the sentence-ending -'o): sangs mi rgya'o 'will not awaken'

མནན་པ: pressing down (mnan, the past stem of gnon 'to press', + -pa)
མིག་ཤེལ: crystal eye(s), glassy eyes (mig 'eye' + shel 'crystal, glass'); the sense is not sure
མིག་ཏུ: as eyes, in the eye (mig 'eye' + -tu 'as, in')
སྤྱི་བོར: on the crown of the head (spyi bo 'crown' + -r 'on')
བཅིངས་པ: bound, tied (bcings, the past stem of 'ching 'to bind', + -pa)
ཁྲམ་ཤིང: tally-stick, a notched stick for scoring deeds (khram 'tally' + shing 'wood')
རྒྱོབ་སོད: strike! kill! (rgyob, imperative of rgyag 'to strike', + sod, imperative of gsod 'to kill')
ཕྲལ་བ: tearing apart, separating (phral, past stem of 'phral 'to separate, tear apart', + -ba)
དོན་སྙིང: organs and heart (don 'a solid organ of the body' + snying 'heart')
འདོན་པ: taking out, pulling out ('don pa 'to take out, to recite')
དེ་ལྟ་བུའི: of that kind, such (de lta bu 'like that' + -'i 'of')
ཁེངས: filled, full (khengs, 'to be full'): khengs nas 'having filled'
བྱུང་བའི: of what has arisen, when (it) has arisen (byung, past of 'byung 'arise', + -ba + -'i 'of')
བསད་པ: killing (bsad, the past stem of gsod 'to kill', + -pa)
བཏུབས་པ: chopping, cutting to pieces (btubs, the past stem of gtub 'to cut up', + -pa)
སྟོང་ཉིད: emptiness (stong 'empty' + nyid '-ness'; Sanskrit śūnyatā), short for stong pa nyid
དངོས་པོ་ཅན་དུ: as having substance, as something real (dngos po 'thing, substance' + can 'having' + -du 'as')
མ་གཏོགས: except, apart from (ma 'not' + gtogs 'to be included')
ཕྱི་རོལ་དུ: outside, in the outer world (phyi rol 'outside' + -du 'in')
དངོས་སུ: really, in fact, actually (dngos 'real, thing' + -su 'as, in')
ཐག་ཆོད་དོ: it is decided, settled (thag 'cord' + chod 'cut', + the sentence-ending -do)
ཐག་ཆོད: decided, settled, certain (thag 'cord' + chod 'cut': 'the cord is cut')
འབྱོན་པར: coming, going ('byon, the respectful 'come, go', + -pa + -r); 'byon par 'dug 'is coming'
འདུག་གོ: is, is in the act of ('dug 'to be, to sit' + the sentence-ending -go)
རྗེས་སུ: after, following (rjes 'after' + -su 'to'): rjes su dran pa 'to recollect'
མཚན: name (mtshan), the respectful word; also a mark, sign
བོས་ཅིག: call! (bos, the past and imperative stem of 'bod 'to call', + cig, which marks a command)
རྒྱུག་ཅིག: run! (rgyug, 'to run', + cig, which marks a command)
བཟུང་ཞིག: hold! (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'to hold', where the imperative is zung, + zhig, which marks a command after -ng)
